description.value:
The bronze inlays of daybreak ammunition glow noticeably, even under direct sunlight. When activated daybreak ammunition hits a target, the missile flares with an aura of bright light in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] from the target for 1 round. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save. Creatures with darkvision take a –2 circumstance penalty to this save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled] for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Blinded] for 1 round.
